description: Test suite for Custom Profile Attributes in Mattermost, including conversion, validation, and patching of custom profile attribute fields.

methods.name: TestNewCPAFieldFromPropertyField
methods.description: Tests conversion from PropertyField to CPAField, verifying attribute parsing and defaults.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldToPropertyField
methods.description: Tests conversion from CPAField to PropertyField, including attribute and managed attribute handling.

methods.name: TestCustomProfileAttributeSelectOptionIsValid
methods.description: Validates the correctness of CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption validation logic.

methods.name: TestCPAField_SanitizeAndValidate
methods.description: Tests sanitization and validation of CPAField properties, options, and managed attributes.

methods.name: TestCPAField_IsAdminManaged
methods.description: Checks if CPAField correctly identifies admin-managed fields.

methods.name: TestCPAField_SetDefaults
methods.description: Verifies default setting for visibility and sort order in CPAField.

methods.name: TestCPAField_Patch
methods.description: Tests patching (updating) CPAField with various attribute modifications, including handling of clearing fields.
